header.shortDesc: Transform your dental hygiene with the SuperMouth ULTIM8 SmartBrush™ System, an advanced electric toothbrush for an oral care with cutting-edge technology, unparalleled convenience, and superior performance—grab your rechargeable electric toothbrush today and elevate your dentist-level clean at home with the best in electric toothbrushes.
header.superHtml:
Introducing the ULTIM8® SmartBrush® System—the first reinvention of the toothbrush in nearly a century. For decades, traditional toothbrushes have fallen short: they are often too abrasive, causing sensitivity and gum recession; they struggle to clean effectively between teeth, where cavities commonly develop; and they are grossly unhygienic, harboring millions of microbes. That’s why we’ve completely reimagined the toothbrush from the ground up.

The ULTIM8 SmartBrush electric toothbrush features patented revolutionary bristles for an unprecedented clean, a pressure sensor to prevent over-brushing, and the groundbreaking SmartHub® with UV sanitizing, drying, and wireless charging for ultimate hygiene. Imagine a rechargeable electric toothbrush so advanced, it feels like you’re visiting the dentist every time you use your toothbrush. Plus, the Travel SmartCase® keeps your toothbrush clean and protected while holding your toothpaste and floss for convenient travel.

For the first time, brushing teeth and gums is safer, more effective, and more hygienic—experience the future of oral care today.

Why Choose the ULTIM8® SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System?

  • Innovative Bristles for Superior Cleaning:

    Patented SuperBristles® Pro technology cleans teeth up to an incredible 40 times better than a manual brush. For those with braces, the SuperBristles® Ortho option ensures thorough cleaning around brackets and wires up to an astonishing 60 times better than a manual toothbrush.

  • Advanced PBT Bristles:

    Most brushes use nylon bristles that can be harsher on teeth and limit bristle density. Our ultra-soft PBT bristles allow us to pack over 3X more bristles into each brush head, delivering a deeper, more precise clean while being gentler on enamel and gums, especially for those experiencing sensitivity from aggressive brushing.

  • Pressure Sensor:

    Prevents over-brushing by indicating optimal pressure in real-time, protecting your tooth enamel and gums.

  • Dual Sonic Modes:

    Customizable cleaning with two sonic toothbrush modes for different levels of intensity and effectiveness.

  • SmartHub®:

    The patent-pending SmartHub features a built-in UV sanitizer that eliminates 99.9% of germs, an integrated dryer, wireless charging, a convenient rinse cup, and a protective cap all in one, ensuring your electric toothbrush is always hygienic and ready to use.

  • SmartCase®:

    The travel SmartCase features a wireless charger, UV sanitizer, and custom spaces for SuperMouth’s travel toothpaste and floss, ensuring your oral care routine stays intact.

  • Waterproof and Wireless Charging:

    Fully waterproof design and wireless SmartMag technology for hassle-free electric toothbrush charging and easy cleaning.

  • Smart Timer:

    Ensures you brush for the dentist-recommended two minutes every time.

cards.title: Revolutionary Bristle Design: A New Era in Oral Care
paras: “Modern” toothbrush bristles, practically unchanged since their invention in 1938, fail to match the anatomy of actual teeth, leading to inefficiency in plaque removal, dental sensitivity, and gum damage.
Our patented bristles conform to your teeth’s contours, reducing sensitivity and providing a superior clean.
We did this by scanning thousands of teeth with and without braces and custom designing the bristles to perfectly contour the natural curves of teeth and around brackets and wires.

cards.title: Say Goodbye to Dirty Toothbrushes
paras: Did you know your toothbrush is dirtier than your toilet and a public restroom floor? Studies show toothbrushes can harbor E. coli, staph, fungi, viruses, millions of other microbes - and fecal matter from toilet flushing.

Our SmartHub stores your SmartBrush between uses and features a UV sanitizer that kills 99.9% of germs, an integrated dryer, a built-in charger, and a rinse cup-ensuring a hygienic brushing experience. Its lights are designed to minimize melatonin disruption during nighttime bathroom trips for better sleep.

cards.title: Protect Your Smile with Smart Technology
paras: Traditional abrasive toothbrushes cause enamel abrasion and gum recession. Our ULTIM8 SmartBrush with patented bristles gently reaches hard-to-clean areas without causing damage.
Using unique super-soft bristles, we included three times more bristles than the industry norm, making the SmartBrush as gentle on teeth and gums as it is effective in removing plaque.
The SmartBrush’s pressure sensor indicator light ensures optimal brushing pressure for safe and effective care.

cards.title: Efficacy Redefined: Revolutionary SuperBristles Pro
paras: Experience the power of our SuperBristles Pro, cleaning teeth up to 40 times better than a manual brush. For those with braces, our SuperBristles Ortho cleans around brackets and wires up to 60 times better, ensuring a thorough and effective clean every time.

cards.title: Ultimate On-the-Go Clean with the Travel SmartCase
paras: The Travel SmartCase keeps your oral care essentials hygienic and fully powered, wherever life takes you. With a built-in UV sanitizer that provides up to 3 weeks of germ protection on a single charge, the ability to recharge your toothbrush for longer trips, and custom spaces for SuperMouth's travel toothpaste and floss, it's the perfect companion for travel. Compact and easy to carry, it ensures your toothbrush stays clean, charged, and protected a must-have for the traveling brusher.

Our SmartBrush, SmartHub, and SmartCase are ergonomically designed and come in a range of stunning colors, ensuring they not only look gorgeous but also feel great to use. Each piece is crafted to elevate your bathroom aesthetic, making your brushing routine feel like a premium experience every time. With the SmartBrush, beauty and functionality go hand in hand, bringing elegance and ease to your oral care.

items.title: FAQs
items.html:
What makes the Ultim8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System different from other sonic toothbrushes?
The ULTIM8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System sets itself apart from other sonic toothbrushes with advanced features like SuperBristles®️ Pro, SmartMag™️ technology, a pressure sensor, and a SmartHub™️ that includes a UV sanitizer and integrated dryer—offering superior cleanliness and protection. The SmartCase®️ adds travel-friendly convenience, and red light technology supports melatonin levels during nighttime brushing. With a rechargeable battery, two-minute timer, and enamel-protecting features, this is a complete, dentist-recommended oral care solution designed for modern, healthier smiles.
How do the SuperBristles Pro and SuperBristles Ortho technologies work?
The ULTIM8 SmartBrush with SuperBristles Pro technology is engineered to deliver exceptional teeth cleaning, offering up to 40 times better oral care performance than a manual brush, while the SuperBristles Ortho version is specially tailored for braces, achieving up to 60 times better dental cleaning around brackets and wires. By scanning thousands of teeth, these bristles were designed to conform precisely to the natural curves of teeth, ensuring a thorough, gentle cleaning for healthier gums and a brighter smile, making it a dentist-recommended choice for those upgrading from standard toothbrushes to Sonic toothbrushes.
What is the purpose of the pressure sensor in the ULTIM8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush?
The pressure sensor plays a vital role in protecting your enamel and gums by detecting excessive pressure and guiding optimal brushing technique. This ensures a safe, dentist-recommended brushing experience. Combined with SuperBristles®️ Pro, SmartMag™️ technology, and the SmartHub’s UV sanitizer, the pressure sensor helps reduce gum irritation, prolong battery life, and elevate overall oral health.
How does the SmartHub enhance the functionality of the Ultim8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System?
The SmartHub is more than just a stand—it’s a multifunctional hygiene station. It houses the brush safely, features a UV sanitizer that kills 99.9% of germs, an integrated dryer to prevent moisture buildup, wireless charging capabilities, and a dual-purpose rinse cup with a protective cap. It’s designed to keep your sonic toothbrush clean, charged, and ready for use every time.
Can I use the Ultim8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System while traveling?
Yes! The ULTIM8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System is perfect for travel thanks to the SmartCase®️, which keeps your sonic toothbrush routine consistent on the go. The SmartCase includes a wireless charger, UV sanitizer, and custom compartments for SuperMouth’s travel-sized toothpaste and floss. This portable system makes it easy to maintain healthy teeth and gums, wherever life takes you.
Is the ULTIM8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush waterproof and easy to clean?
Absolutely. The ULTIM8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush is fully waterproof, making it safe for shower use and easy to rinse clean. It’s powered by a rechargeable battery and utilizes SmartMag™️ wireless charging, so there are no exposed ports to worry about. This makes it durable, low-maintenance, and ideal for anyone looking to upgrade to a premium sonic toothbrush.
How do I clean the ULTIM8 SmartHub?
For optimal cleanliness, remove the top rinse cap and bottom cover weekly to clear out excess water. Use the ULTIM8 HubMate™️ Microfiber Cleaning Tool, specially designed for detailed cleaning of every surface. The microfiber cloth is detachable for easy rinsing and reuse.
How does the Smart Timer feature benefit my oral health?
The Smart Timer helps ensure you brush for the dentist-recommended two minutes, encouraging proper cleaning technique and coverage. It supports better oral hygiene by promoting even brushing across all areas of the mouth, reinforcing healthy brushing habits for a more effective clean with your sonic toothbrush.
How often do the bristles need to be replaced?
To maintain peak performance and hygiene, we recommend replacing the SuperBristles®️ every 6 weeks. These premium bristles are softer and more effective than standard ones but wear faster due to their gentleness and deep-cleaning action. Regular replacement ensures continued protection for your teeth and gums.
What age groups is this brush and system designed for?
The ULTIM8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System is designed for adults, teens, and pre-teens. It offers gentle, thorough care for various stages of oral development and is ideal for those with sensitive gums. Specialized SuperBristles®️ Ortho brush heads are also available for users with braces.
What is the warranty on the Ultim8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System?
The Ultim8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System comes with a lifetime warranty for subscribers who receive SuperBristles®️ Pro or Ortho replacements every 3 months (recommended for changing every 6 weeks). Without a subscription, the ULTIM8 SmartBrush, SmartHub, and SmartCase are backed by a 365-day limited warranty. See the full warranty policy for more details.
What other oral care products should be used with the Ultim8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System?
To enhance your experience with the Ultim8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush System, we recommend pairing it with one of our complete oral care kits designed for different stages and needs, including the 'Teens & Adults' and 'Orthodontic' systems. Examples of these systems are: The Teens & Adults Basic System includes a toothbrush, toothpaste, and floss, while the Teens & Adults Plus System adds a tongue scraper and mouth spray, and the Complete System further includes mouthwash. For those with braces or aligners, the Orthodontic System features specialized products to help clean effectively around brackets and wires.
What makes the ULTIM8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush different from a regular toothbrush?
The ULTIM8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush features patented SuperBristles®️ Pro technology that cleans teeth up to 40x better than a manual brush. It also includes innovative features like dual sonic modes, a pressure sensor, a SmartTimer, and advanced accessories for optimal oral care.
Is the ULTIM8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush suitable for people with braces?
Yes! The ULTIM8 SmartBrush electric toothbrush offers a SuperBristles®️ Ortho option, specially designed to clean around braces up to 60x better than a manual toothbrush, ensuring a deep and effective clean.
How does the pressure sensor work?
The built-in pressure sensor provides real-time feedback to help prevent over-brushing, protecting your tooth enamel and gums by ensuring you apply the right amount of pressure.
What are the dual sonic modes?
The ULTIM8 SmartBrush electric toothbrush includes two customizable sonic modes that allow you to choose different levels of intensity and effectiveness to suit your brushing preferences.
What is the SmartHub®️ and what does it do?
The patent-pending SmartHub is a multifunctional base for your SmartBrush. It includes a UV sanitizer that kills 99.9% of germs, an integrated dryer, wireless charging dock, rinse cup, and a protective cap—keeping your brush clean, charged, and ready to use.
What features are included in the travel SmartCase®️?
The SmartCase is a travel-friendly accessory that includes a wireless charger, UV sanitizer, and storage for SuperMouth’s travel-sized toothpaste and floss. It will be shipped separately starting Spring 2025.
How does the SmartTimer help with brushing?
The SmartTimer ensures that you brush for the dentist-recommended two minutes every time, promoting consistent and effective oral hygiene.
How is the ULTIM8 SmartBrush Electric Toothbrush charged?
The brush uses SmartMag wireless charging technology for hassle-free recharging—just place it in the SmartHub or SmartCase and it charges without the need for cables or plugs.
